pages.scan: Opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-02.png with Read and looked at it before reading any other document. The image loaded and was readable. It shows 4 panels: a wide top panel, a middle row split into a wider left and narrower right panel, and a wide bottom panel. There are two teal label boxes.
pages.observation: My reading order was P1 caption 'The clinic begins its Welbuk onboarding.' (top-left), then the teal label 'WELBUK PRACTICE for the clinic' (top-right). Next came P2, Ananya: 'We can organise our clinic workflow here.' Then P3, Meera: 'And our team can use tools suited to each staff role.', followed by the label 'WELBUK CARE for clinic staff' at the bottom of P3. Last was P4: 'One team. Better coordination.', whose short tail points left to Ananya, with Meera on the right. All speakers were clear and the 'And our team...' line follows naturally from Ananya's line. Issues: (1) It is never shown what Welbuk is (software, a service?). 'Onboarding' and 'here' have nothing visible in the storyboard to refer to, so the reader needs a screen or device in P1/P2 to make 'here' concrete. (2) The P1 caption box and teal label sit flush against or overlap the top panel border. (3) In P4 the balloon covers Ananya's placeholder label ('anany...') and sits very close to her face area. Her face placement needs checking. (4) The time jump from the page 1 conversation to the onboarding has no time cue beyond the caption.
